name: The keeper of the Hanged Ferryman
descriptor: a heavyset keeper with scarred knuckles
notes: The first-slice tavern is the persistent world's default start, so he is the first person most players ever see. WARNING: he stood at (27,14) for a long time, which is not a tile a body can occupy -- the server silently moved him to the area spawn every load. validate:content refuses that now. ⚠ HIT POINTS (D-619): 40, where every NPC silently had the world's spawn default of ten -- a number set for test fixtures that no content file could ever reach. The arithmetic, measured rather than guessed: a level-1 character with the arming sword its kit grants swings at +3 against an unarmoured AC of 10, so it hits about seven times in ten for a flat 3, which is 2.1 a swing; a basic character gets ONE swing per four-second combat round (D-550). Ten hit points was therefore five swings and twenty seconds, and the stakeholder's note is that the objective is 'over in seconds if the player directly attacks the keeper'. Forty is about nineteen swings and seventy seconds of standing over somebody in the open square where D-549 put every route -- long enough for the watch to close (D-619 makes it run) and for anybody crossing to see it. That is the fight this objective is supposed to be about. It halves for two attackers, which is D-529's buddy system doing its job rather than a leak. UNRATIFIED, and the first number to move if a minute of swinging reads as a chore rather than as a scene.
